mPDF Source (Local Note)
=======================
PHP sources for mPDF HTML-to-PDF rendering.

Highlights
----------
- Core: Mpdf.php, ServiceFactory.php, CssManager.php, HTMLParserMode.php, PageFormat.php
- Rendering: Pdf/, Writer/, Output/, Shaper/
- Content: Tag/, Css/, Image/, Gif/
- Fonts: Fonts/, TTFontFile*, Ucdn.php, Otl.php
- Utilities: Utils/, Cache.php, RemoteContentFetcher.php, SizeConverter.php, Strict.php, TableOfContents.php
- Errors: Exception/

Notes
-----
- Vendor code; avoid local changes. Prefer upstream upgrades and validate rendering.
